name: Sematic
tagline: A collaborative whiteboard that turns spoken commands, text or images into structured diagrams live.

awards: Amazon: AWS Campus Champions - Best Use of DynamoDB Streams

problem: Drawing diagrams by hand during a discussion kills momentum.
solution: A spatially aware whiteboard executes commands such as adding a database connected to a service or deleting nodes on one side, from voice, text or uploaded images, collaboratively.
demo_moment: Team-described: say "add a user database connected to the auth service" and watch it appear.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Amazon: AWS Campus Champions - Best Use of DynamoDB Streams” among 261 submissions.
Understands spatial references, not just commands.

lessons: Voice-to-diagram demos well because the change is instant and visible.
